notes.title: Antipsychotic Retirement from Steam
notes.notes:
I am announcing the retirement of Antipsychotic from the Steam platform. For those who have already purchased it, rest assured it will remain accessible in your account. This decision arises from my commitment to pushing boundaries in mental health narratives.

Antipsychotic embodies a unique exploration of storytelling methods. Its full expression is realized through an XR installation, featuring haptics, multiple displays, meticulously designed sets, and immersive surround sound. These elements are crucial for delivering its full narrative experience.

Unfortunately, without these essential components, Antipsychotic's core essence is incomplete. As I continue to explore new media and innovative approaches to mental health storytelling, I will tailor specific experiences for PC-only use.

Antipsychotic will now return to its original form as a physical installation. I believe this format best captures its essence and ensures its narrative is fully realized.

Thank you for your support and understanding as I continue to explore mental health storytelling.
